question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] 

**Logic: **First letter is exactly opposite of second letter and First letter - 3 = Third letter

 
• KPH → K ↔ P; K - 3 = H
 
• GTD → G ↔ T; G - 3 = D
 
• DWA → D ↔ W; D - 3 = A
 
• **EVC → E ↔ V; E - 3 = B ≠ C**

Hence, '**EVC**' is the correct answer.
